scanner: Gitleaks 8.24.3, default rules; redacted reports in ignored outputs/local-ai-security
new_data: Synthetic/public aggregate evaluation receipts and genuine browser screenshots only. No private datasets, raw public source files, model weights, databases, environment credentials or generated secrets staged.
final_gate: Final staged snapshot is scanned again before local commit; new commit history is scanned after commit. No push, merge, PR or deploy authorized.
limits: A clean scanner is evidence from these rules, not a proof about every possible secret. Intended source, fixture provenance and exports also reviewed.
